day_local: Arbacada Toddobaadka Laba iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Kuwa ku raaca, Rabbiyow, waxay yeelan doonaan nuurka nolosha.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'geedka lagu beeray meel biyo socdaan'. Sabuurka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in ninka xaqqa ah uu yahay sida geedka oo kale: 'Wuxuu u eg yahay geed lagu beeray meel biyo socdaan, oo midhihiisa dhalaya xilligooda.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil si joogto ah u cabbayay biyaha nolosha ee Ilaah. Ma aha oo kaliya inuu ahaa wiil caqli badan oo yaqaanay sida loo qoro koodhka, ama wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, laakiin wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu ku xirnaa ilaha jacaylka. Sida geedka oo kale, Ben wuxuu lahaa xididdo qoto dheer. Xididdadaas waxay ahaayeen iimaankiisa, jacaylka uu u qabay qoyskiisa, iyo naxariistiisa aan xad lahayn.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Laakiin waxa gudaha ku jira, sadaqo bixiya, oo bal eeg, wax walba way idiin nadiif noqonayaan.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo bixiyo. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaanan noqon kuwa culeys saara dadka kale, laakiin aan noqonno kuwa naxariista leh.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil naxariistaas qabay. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya. Waxaad maqli kartaa codkiisa oo leh: 'Baah, waan fiicanahay.' Sida uu aabihiis ku arkay riyadii, Ben wuxuu u muuqday mid caafimaad qaba, xoog leh, oo faraxsan. Taasi waa ballanqaadkii Ilaah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka naxariista Ilaah uu weli idin sugayo, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga ku soo degto, maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin si sacramental ah. Ii imow ruux ahaan, oo igu dhex noolow si aan weligay kaaga go'in. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo wajigiisa ha idiin iftiimiyo. Nabadda Masiixu ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhoweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa, oo ay ku nastaan nabad weligeed ah.
Qoysaska ay hayso murugada iyo cidladu, inuu Rabbigu u soo dejiyo raaxada Ruuxa Quduuska ah, oo uu siiyo rajo ay nolol cusub ku bilaabaan.

readings.label: Akhrinta Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Haddii Ruuxu idin hoggaamiyo, idinku sharciga hoostiisa ma tihidin. Hadda shuqullada jidhku way muuqdaan: sinada, wasakhnimada, xumaanta, sanam caabudidda, sixirka, nacaybka, dirirta, masayrka, cadhada, danaysiga, qaybsanaanta, xisbiyada, xaasidnimada, sakhraannimada, ciyaaraha iyo waxyaalaha la midka ah. Waxaan idiin digayaa, sidii aan horay idiinku digay, in kuwa waxyaalahan sameeya aysan dhaxli doonin boqortooyada Ilaah. Laakiin midhaha Ruuxu waa jacayl, farxad, nabad, dulqaad, naxariis, deeqsinimo, aaminnimo, qabow, is-xakameyn. Waxyaalahaas sharcigu kama soo horjeedo. Kuwa Masiix Ciise iska leh waxay iskutallaabta ku qodbeen jidhkooda iyo damacyadiisa iyo rabitaankiisa. Haddii aynu Ruuxa ku nool nahay, aynu sidoo kale Ruuxa ku soconno.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Kuwa ku raaca, Rabbiyow, waxay yeelan doonaan nuurka nolosha. Barakaysan ninka aan raacin talada kuwa sharka leh, oo aan ku socon jidka dembiilayaasha, oo aan fadhiisan meesha ay fadhiistaan kuwa wax quudhsada, laakiin ku raaxaysta sharciga Rabbiga, oo sharcigiisa ka fikira habeen iyo maalin. R. Kuwa ku raaca, Rabbiyow, waxay yeelan doonaan nuurka nolosha. Wuxuu u eg yahay geed lagu beeray meel biyo socdaan, oo midhihiisa dhalaya xilligooda, oo caleentiisu aysan engegin. Wax kasta oo uu sameeyo way barwaaqoobaan. R. Kuwa ku raaca, Rabbiyow, waxay yeelan doonaan nuurka nolosha. Sidaas ma aha kuwa sharka leh; waxay u eg yihiin qashin dabayshu kaxayso. Waayo Rabbigu wuxuu ilaaliyaa jidka kuwa xaqqa ah, laakiin jidka kuwa sharka leh wuu baabba'aa. R. Kuwa ku raaca, Rabbiyow, waxay yeelan doonaan nuurka nolosha.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi: 'Waa idiin hoog, Fariisiyow! Waayo waxaad bixisaan toban meelood oo reexaan iyo rue iyo khudaarta beerta oo dhan, laakiin waxaad iska indho tirtaan caddaaladda iyo jacaylka Ilaah. Waxyaalahan waa inaad samaysaan, adigoon kuwa kale iska indho tirin. Waa idiin hoog, Fariisiyow! Waayo waxaad jeceshihiin kursiga sharafta leh ee sunagogyada iyo salaanta suuqyada. Waa idiin hoog! Waayo waxaad u eg tihiin xabaalo aan la arkayn oo dadku ay dushooda ku socdaan iyagoon ogayn.' Markaas mid ka mid ah culimada sharciga ayaa ugu jawaabay, 'Macallimow, hadalkaaga noo caayayaa.' Wuxuuna yidhi, 'Waa idiin hoog idinkana culimada sharciga! Waayo dadka waxaad saartaan culaysyo ay adag tahay in la qaado, laakiin idinku far keliya kama taabataan.'

day: Wednesday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
